# My Cleveland Clinic

> Patient portal and healthcare hub providing appointment scheduling, medical records access, provider search, and comprehensive health information from Cleveland Clinic.

My Cleveland Clinic serves as the primary digital gateway for patients and visitors, offering integrated access to MyChart patient portal, appointment scheduling, provider directories, and evidence-based medical reference content. The site supports Cleveland Clinic's multi-state and international healthcare operations across Ohio, Florida, Nevada, and international locations.

## Key Topics

- MyChart Patient Portal
- Appointment Scheduling
- Virtual Care
- Provider Directory
- Medical Reference Library
- Diseases & Conditions
- Symptoms & Diagnostics
- Treatments & Procedures
- Health Education
- Patient Resources
- Medical Professionals
- Body Systems
- Medications & Supplements
- Cleveland Clinic Locations
- Patient Portal Access

## Patient Portal & Appointments

- [Cleveland Clinic: Every Life Deserves World Class Care](https://my.clevelandclinic.org): Cleveland Clinic homepage with MyChart patient portal and healthcare services
- [MyChart | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/online-services/mychart): MyChart patient portal for medical records, appointments, and messaging
- [Appointments | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/patients/information/access): Appointment scheduling and virtual visit access via MyChart

## Find Care & Providers

- [Find a Provider | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/providers): Provider directory and search tool for finding Cleveland Clinic doctors
- [Services | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/services): Cleveland Clinic services directory covering institutes and specialties
- [Patients and Visitors | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/patients): Patient information and visitor guide for Cleveland Clinic appointments

## Health Information & Medical Reference

- [Medical Questions & Answers | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health): Medical Q&A and health library with answers from Cleveland Clinic doctors
- [Diseases & Conditions | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases): Disease and condition directory with diagnosis and treatment information
- [Symptoms | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms): A-Z symptom lookup and reference guide from Cleveland Clinic
- [Body Systems & Organs | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/body): A-Z health reference guide for body systems and organ information
- [Treatments | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/treatments): Medical treatments reference with risks, benefits, and usage information
- [Procedures | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/procedures): A-Z medical procedures directory with Cleveland Clinic information
- [Diagnostics & Testing | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diagnostics): Diagnostic and testing procedures directory from Cleveland Clinic
- [Drugs, Devices & Supplements | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/drugs): A-Z directory of medications, devices, and supplements with information

## Professional Resources

- [Resources for Medical Professionals | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/professionals): Medical professional resources including referrals and continuing education

## Support & Help

- [Frequently Asked Questions: Get Answers Fast | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/help): FAQ and help center for appointments, billing, insurance, and services
- [Construction Alerts | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/locations/construction-alerts): Construction alerts and parking updates for Cleveland Clinic locations

## Optional

- [Give to Cleveland Clinic | Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/giving): Philanthropic giving and donation opportunities at Cleveland Clinic
